summary: Carry the current canonical Karmic runtime into beta: DeepSeek V4.1 decode prefetch and compact IQ2/Q8_0 checkpoints
details: DeepSeek V4.1 decode prefetches the next weights into L2 and reads disk Engram rows for both Engram layers concurrently; the NVFP4 Markov head stays opt-in (VLLM_DS41_MARKOV_NVFP4=1).
ModelOpt IQ2_XS, IQ2_XXS and Q8_0 checkpoints load through compact B12X dense, expert, embedding and LM-head paths.
